items.scientific_object: Thermodynamic gap Delta=2W|epsilon|.

items.scientific_object: Relaxation time tau=hbar/Delta=tau0/|epsilon|.

items.scientific_object: Microscopic timescale tau0=hbar/(2W).

items.scientific_object: Critical sound speed c=2Wa/hbar.

items.scientific_object: Healing length xi=a/|epsilon|=xi0/|epsilon|.

items.scientific_object: Microscopic length xi0=a.

items.scientific_object: Linear quench epsilon(t)=t/tauQ.

items.scientific_object: For the linear quench, epsilon/dot(epsilon)=t.
